title: Warren Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Chairman, Names Son to Replace Him
summary: Warren Buffett announced his resignation as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, appointing his son Howard Buffett as successor, marking a historic leadership transition for one of the world's largest and most influential investment conglomerates after decades of Buffett's legendary stewardship.
problem_solved: Addresses the long-anticipated succession planning challenge for Berkshire Hathaway following Buffett's retirement at age 96.
why_valuable: Provides critical insight into the transition of a company valued at over $900 billion, affecting millions of shareholders and setting a precedent for corporate succession planning.
